title.full: Using MediSave for siblings' medical expenses

summary.text: Yes. You may use your MediSave if your siblings are Singapore Citizens or Permanent Residents, and you provide proof.

steps.name: Check their status
steps.text: Confirm that your siblings are Singapore Citizens or Permanent Residents (SC/PR).

steps.name: Provide proof
steps.text: Provide the medical institutions with proof that your siblings are SC/PR, such as their NRICs.

example_phrasings: Can I use my MediSave for my siblings' medical expenses?
Can MediSave pay for my siblings' medical bills?
Can I pay for my brothers' or sisters' medical care with MediSave?

sources.page_title: Can I use my MediSave for my siblings' medical expenses?

quotes.text: You may use your MediSave to pay for your siblings' medical expenses, as long as they are Singapore Citizens or Permanent Residents (SC/PR).
You would have to provide proof to the medical institutions that your siblings are SC/PR (e.g. NRICs).
